summary: Comprehensive end-to-end verification of the sessionStorage→httpOnly-cookie admin-auth migration plus Navigation/Contact refactor. 13/13 backend pytest pass; admin login/dashboard/CRUD/logout flow works via cookies only; HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie is invisible to document.cookie; sessionStorage holds ONLY {email,id} (no token); navigation dropdowns and contact form behave per spec.
passed_tests: POST /api/admin/login with admin@myaibo.in/admin123 → 200 + Set-Cookie: admin_token=...; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None; Path=/
Wrong password → 401, no cookie set, no token in sessionStorage
GET /api/admin/me with cookie → 200 returning {email,id}; without cookie → 401
GET /api/admin/blogs and /api/admin/case-studies require auth (401 unauth, 200 with cookie)
Blog CRUD via cookie: create (201) → get (200) → update (200, persisted) → delete (204) → get (404)
Case Study CRUD via cookie: full lifecycle persisted
POST /api/contact accepts payload and returns success status
AdminLogin UI: error rendered on wrong creds; sessionStorage contains NO admin_token key; document.cookie does NOT expose admin_token (only PostHog/GA cookies)
AdminDashboard mounts via /admin/me cookie probe; only {email,id} cached in sessionStorage.admin_user
/admin/blogs and /admin/case-studies pages load real data via cookie auth (no Authorization header sent)
Logout button clears sessionStorage and redirects to /admin
Direct visit to /admin/dashboard after logout → redirected to /admin login

Desktop Solutions dropdown opens on click, lists Marketing (GEO/AEO/SEO/Content Marketing) + Technology (AI Automation/White Label/Full Stack); closes on outside click and Escape; aria-expanded toggles true→false correctly
Desktop Resources dropdown trigger toggles aria-expanded true→false on Escape
Mobile hamburger reveals Solutions/Resources sections and accordion is clickable
Contact form submit shows success state and Send Another resets the form
critical_code_review_comments: constants.js BACKEND_URL fix correctly normalises trailing /api — good defensive code.
adminApi.js uses credentials:'include' consistently; AdminAuthError is thrown on 401 enabling clean redirect-to-login. No Authorization header is constructed anywhere in frontend.
AdminDashboard does an early /admin/me probe before showing data; sessionStorage is used only as a non-sensitive display cache (email,id). XSS exfiltration surface for the JWT is eliminated.

Backend admin_api.py still accepts Bearer header as a fallback in require_admin(). This is documented and safe (no client uses it now), but keep an eye on it — consider removing the fallback once mobile/SSR clients are confirmed cookie-only.

Minor: PostHog session-recorder still issues background fetches against /admin/* after logout, producing benign 401 console errors. Not a defect; just noisy. Could be silenced by registering an exclusion in PostHog config.
React strict-mode warns about UNSAFE_componentWillMount from a third-party dep (not application code) — informational only.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed blogs and case studies and delete them in the same run; no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie auth migration is fully validated end-to-end. The pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_admin_cookie_auth.py is the regression suite for admin auth + CRUD; run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. PostHog produces benign 401 logs after logout — ignore those. The /admin/me probe pattern in AdminDashboard.js is the canonical example for any future protected page (use adminGet('/me') + AdminAuthError → navigate('/admin')).
